description.narrative: (Tanzania): &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;!--td {border: 1px solid #ccc;}br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}--&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;!--td {border: 1px solid #ccc;}br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}--&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;The Data-Driven Advocacy activity supports U.S. government objectives by promoting values such as respect for human rights, including access to information, and the freedoms of expression and association. FY 2021 funds will strengthen Tanzanian civil society organizations focused on human rights by improving their advocacy skills through training, mentorship, and coaching. These organizations will also be supported by providing them access to analysis and strategy development tools, and both international and domestic expertise. As a result, these organizations will lead on monitoring, collection, and use of information around rights issues and create stronger and more diverse coalitions to provide a greater collective voice on issues. With stronger capacity, these local organizations are better placed to pursue strategic litigation to challenge illegal or unconstitutional behavior. USAID will also train them in the use of media (both old and new) as an information dissemination tool, both to further advocacy as well as help promote the value of civil society organizations in a robust democracy. The activity will also provide grants to support the ongoing work of key organizations and networks. ...
